brief:
A Spanish prosecutor recommended Friday that James Cox Chambers Jr., a multimillionaire US media heir and pro-Palestinian donor, be extradited to the United States, Al-Monitor reported. The recommendation supports a US extradition request against Chambers, whose defense team argues the case is politically motivated.

The case centers on Chambers, who has provided significant financial support to Palestinian causes. Spanish authorities must now decide whether to proceed with the extradition, which would transfer the matter to the US legal system.
dek: MADRID, Nov 13 (Reuters) - A Spanish prosecutor on Friday expressed support for a US request to extradite pro-Palestinian donor and multimillionaire US media heir James Cox Chambers Jr, in a case Chambers' defence says is politically motivated.
title: Spain's prosecutor backs extradition of pro-Palestinian US media heir
